      • getOrElse

        @Contract(value="null, _, _ -> param3; _, null, _ -> param3; _, _, !null -> !null",
          pure=true)
public static <T> T getOrElse(@Nullable
                                                                                                                                       T[] array,
                                                                                                                                       @Nullable
                                                                                                                                       @Nullable Integer index,
                                                                                                                                       @Nullable
                                                                                                                                       T defaultValue)
        Get an element from an array by its index or return a default value if the index is out of range or resulting element is null.

        Wraps getNoCheck(Object[], int).

        Possible failure cases:

        • Provided array is null.
        • Provided index is null.
        • Resulting element is null.
        Type Parameters:
        T - element type
        Parameters:
        array - array to get element from, may be null
        index - index of element to get, may be null
        defaultValue - default value to return on failure, may be null
        Returns:
        element corresponding to its index or the default value
